ache.title: The Resonium database: a checklist with no end
ache.note: A full tour of Hollow Zero: licenses, Resonia, corruptions, tile types, how to max your rewards, and finally ‘completing the Resonium database’. Collection logs feel satisfying, but they turn a fun mode into boxes to tick. And look at Nero begging for likes and subscribes at the end. He had a loop of his own.
watch: runs that start to feel like a job
ache.tip: Play Hollow Zero for the runs you enjoy. An empty slot in a database won’t miss you.
lines: a database is a chore with a cover
like and subscribe, he says. oh, Nero

title: Hollow Zero In-Depth Review | Zenless Zone Zero
